# hush_cloudflare_r2_access_credential (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a Cloudflare R2 access credential in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_cloudflare_r2_access_credential" "example" {
  id = "acr-eu12345678"
}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.hush_cloudflare_r2_access_credential.example.account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Cloudflare R2 access credential

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The Cloudflare account ID: 32 lowercase hex characters. Changing it requires a new `api_token` (or a bumped `api_token_wo_version`)
- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment
- `description` (String) The description of the Cloudflare R2 access credential
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `name` (String) The name of the Cloudflare R2 access credential
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
